messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By what date is the Commission required to present its first report on the evaluation and review of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, as set out in Article 53(1)?

response.text: Entro quale data la Commissione è tenuta a presentare la sua prima relazione sulla valutazione e sul riesame del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230, come stabilito dall'articolo 53, paragrafo 1?
